comment: BUILD.GATE.3 — last-known-synced state of deployed edge functions. ezbr_sha256 comes from `npx supabase functions list`; it hashes the deployed bundle, so it cannot be recomputed from source — it changes on every deploy. `npm run drift` compares live values against this file: a mismatch means someone deployed (e.g. via dashboard) since the repo was last synced, i.e. the repo copy may be stale. After any intentional deploy or repo re-sync, update the sha here in the same commit.
